name: Dr. rer. nat. Xuke Hu
title: Senior Researcher (Permanent)
affiliation: German Aerospace Center (DLR), Institute of Data Science
researchSummary: My primary research focus lies in GeoAI, with particular interest in extracting and analyzing geospatial information embedded in large volumes of unstructured and multilingual natural language text. The goal is to uncover new geospatial perspectives from texts and make such information accessible across languages and regions.
